QuestInfo.name: Knighthood Examination 1
QuestInfo.0: It's time for you to take your first test.
QuestInfo.1: Eliminate the exam monsters within the time limit. The monsters don't attack, but they have a lot of health, so the purpose of this test is the measure your attack power. \n#n#bGo see #eMatthias#n in Kerning City.#k

0.0: The first exam will test your strength. Matthias, one of my scouts at Kerning City, will assist. Talk to him, go to the Entry Testing Grounds, and eliminate Exam Instructor Tae Roon.

no.0: I didn't think you were ready anyway.

0.1: He won't fight back, but beating him in the time limit will require you to actually put some effort into it. Do not disappoint me.
0.2: I'll send you to Kerning City right now, if you want. Find Matthias and tell him you want to take the exam.

1.0: You passed the first exam. I will give you the next one soon. It's only the start, so good luck!

default.0: Go to Kerning City and meet with Matthias.
